name: poc-origin-chromium
description: Isolated PoC for lot L5 (goal-6t00P5LW). Tests whether declarativeNetRequest can forge the WebSocket Origin header Wingpen's broker relies on, from a service worker, an extension page, and an offscreen document. Never wired into Wingpen. Run only by the admin in Brave (this sandbox has no AF_UNIX, Chromium cannot start here).
